definitions.explanation: Doing something without difficulty or strain, in a relaxed and comfortable manner.

examples.japanese: {楽々|らくらく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げた→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち}→座り心地：10669_suwarigokochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧、{楽々|らくらく}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This chair is comfortable and makes it easy to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{楽々|らくらく}⟦こなせる→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: With the new software, even complex data processing can be handled with ease.

notes:
A reduplication of ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ (easy, comfortable). Functions as an adverb, often followed by ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ ({楽々|らくらく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧). Conveys a sense of performing a task without visible effort or strain.

USAGE:
Commonly used in product marketing and advertising to emphasize ease of use (e.g., {楽々|らくらく}⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ "easy operation"). Also appears in brand names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽々|らくらく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to carry easily
- {楽々|らくらく}⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧: easy operation
- {楽々|らくらく}⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧: easily cleared/completed
- {楽々|らくらく}⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧: easy storage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: simply, easily — more neutral and objective
- ⟦すらすら→すらすら：05363_surasura⟧: smoothly, fluently — specifically for smooth, uninterrupted flow (reading, speaking)
- ⟦{難|なん}なく→難なく：14596_nannaku⟧: without difficulty — slightly more formal
